patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Clay and Instantly share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Clay and Instantly share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose Clay only if your buying job matches “GTM data enrichment and workflow platform for multi-provider waterfall prospecting — Free ” rather than Instantly's shape. Choose Instantly only if your buying job matches “Cold-email outreach infrastructure — Growth from $47/mo; Hypergrowth $97; Light Speed $358” rather than Clay's shape. Workflow advantage: Clay leans data-enrichment, lead-management; Instantly leans sales-engagement. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Clay and Instantly share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Clay is GTM data enrichment and workflow platform for multi-provider waterfall prospecting — Free + Launch from ~$167/mo headline, Growth, Enterpris; Instantly is Cold-email outreach infrastructure — Growth from $47/mo; Hypergrowth $97; Light Speed $358; bundles/credits add-ons; Enterprise custom..
- Company-size focus: Clay (small-business, mid-market, enterprise) vs Instantly (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Clay-leaning data-enrichment, lead-management vs Instantly-leaning sales-engagement.
- Researched limits: Clay — Learning curve is steep for non-technical GTM users — table/waterfall mental model; Instantly — Cold-email infra first — not an SI contact-database core.

Limitations — Clay: Learning curve is steep for non-technical GTM users — table/waterfall mental model; Credit consumption across providers requires ongoing cost governance; Instantly: Cold-email infra first — not an SI contact-database core; Lead finder/credits are add-on depth vs dedicated SI databases.
